name: proof-command-reopen
about: QA proofs (docs/decisions/2026-10-18-qa-proofs.md), the command kind failing. The build's proof is one command that fails on main. The first proof pass records the failure and the thread says so (failed once; checked again in 30 minutes, a second failure reopens it); the board's QA column shows it under failed. 30 minutes later it fails again: the loop reopens the item as the user's Reopen does: a P2 item in triage with the failure as its ask, linked by reopen_of, and this one is done, actor 'loop (proof)'.

proof.run: test -f chime.wav || { echo 'chime.wav is not on main'; exit 1; }

messages.text: ^Proof check failed once, checked again before it reopens: command: `test -f chime\.wav \|\| \{ echo 'chime\.wav is not on main'; exit 1; \}`: exit 1 after 0s: chime\.wav is not on main\. I check again in 30 minutes; a second failure in a row reopens it\.$

a.card: failed[\s\S]*exit 1 after 0s: chime.wav is not on main

data.words: ^Proof failed 2 times in a row: command: `test -f chime\.wav .*`: exit 1 after 0s: chime\.wav is not on main$

messages.text: ^Reopened by loop \(proof\): 'Proof failed 2 times in a row: .*'\. Filed #2 \(P2\) with those words; this one is done\.$
